name: npm Registry API
rate_limits: No published rate limits for read-only access. Download count API at api.npmjs.org. Search endpoint supports pagination. Responses are CDN-cached.
notes: Public registry for 3M+ JavaScript/Node.js packages. No auth required for read operations. Key endpoints: GET /<package> for full metadata (packument), GET /-/v1/search?text=<query> for search, GET api.npmjs.org/downloads/point/<period>/<package> for download stats. Supports filtered responses (application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json) that reduce payload from ~410kB to ~21kB. Excellent for dependency analysis, package popularity metrics, and JavaScript ecosystem intelligence.
